event_calendar_assignment: UTC date and ISO week of the entry next-open timestamp
gap_semantics: A triggered event is scanned causally within its current exact-contiguous M5 segment. If target/failure triggers and its next-open execution exists before the first gap, the event completes. If no executable trigger occurs and the frozen time exit is unavailable before a gap, the event is right-censored at that gap.
censored_overlap_release: After a right-censored event, the cell may evaluate new signals only from the first bar of the next exact-contiguous segment; no synthetic cross-gap exit is created.
daily_family_statistic: For each architecture cell and UTC entry date, first average completed event gross bps within symbol; then equal-weight those symbol-day means across symbols.
route_statistic: TREND and RANGE route means are arithmetic means of completed event gross bps within the route and are support gates, not separate multiplicity families.
maxT_statistic: mean of daily-family gross bps divided by ISO-week cluster-robust standard error; shared ISO-week wild-sign flips applied to centered daily-family observations; 4999 resamples seed 20260930.
